workload.note: Played full 2025 season, including finale vs. Giants (cbssports.com, 2026-01-04).
Season ended Week 9 (2024-11-03) vs. Falcons with a right leg/hamstring partial tendon avulsion requiring season-ending surgery. Completion % (64.7%) was his lowest since 2017 pre-injury.
